regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in AI compute, software platforms, memory, and selected industrials, but the desk has no scored history, so conviction remains modest. NVDA has the broadest independent alignment; GOOGL, MSFT, MU, and BA offer narrower non-extended reads, while retail-heavy signals elsewhere are less actionable.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要汇聚于AI算力、软件平台、存储芯片及部分工业股，但本桌尚无已评分历史，因此置信度保持克制。NVDA的独立信号覆盖最广；GOOGL、MSFT、MU和BA则提供较窄但尚未过度延伸的机会，其余偏散户情绪的信号可操作性较弱。

theses.thesis: The pack's strongest convergence combines smart-money additions, dark-pool accumulation, developer momentum, patent activity, and a near-unanimous analyst cluster [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. Disclosed holdings by Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Michael McCaul add actor breadth without proving causality [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The shares are non-extended and have lagged SPY over 60 days, so this is not a momentum chase; earnings in 18 days make the path event-sensitive.
theses.thesis_zh: 该证据包中最强的汇聚来自聪明资金增持、暗池吸筹、开发者动能、专利活动及高度一致的分析师看多集群 [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。Nancy Pelosi、Marjorie Taylor Greene和Michael McCaul的披露持仓增加了参与者广度，但并不证明因果关系 [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。股价未处于过度延伸状态，且过去60日跑输SPY，因此并非追涨；18天后公布财报使路径高度依赖事件结果。
second_order: MU — memory demand is a second-order beneficiary of sustained AI-compute deployment, with its own insider, patent, and analyst convergence.
MSFT — cloud and AI-platform monetization can benefit from continued accelerator adoption and is supported by app, developer, and patent signals.
CEG — AI data-center expansion implies greater power demand, though its own convergence is only three channels.
theses.dissent: Retail buzz and analyst unanimity may reflect a crowded consensus, while the imminent earnings event can overwhelm the slower-moving alternative-data signals.

falsifier.text: Dark-pool accumulation reverses while developer and model-download momentum weaken after the next earnings report.

theses.thesis: App demand, model-download momentum, open-source developer activity, lobbying, and analyst upgrades align across product usage, ecosystem adoption, policy engagement, and institutional opinion [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum] [lobbying] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. theses.thesis_zh: 应用需求、模型下载动能、开源开发者活动、游说投入和分析师上调，分别从产品使用、生态采用、政策参与和机构观点形成汇聚 [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum] [lobbying] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。Nancy Pelosi的披露持仓增加了一项参与者信号 [actor:Nancy Pelosi]。该股未过度延伸，过去60日明显跑输SPY，因此相对于信号广度而言，入场拥挤度较低。
second_order: NVDA — continued model usage and developer activity support accelerator demand, although NVDA has stronger standalone convergence.
MSFT — broader AI application adoption validates cloud-platform demand across the competing hyperscaler complex.
CEG — expanding AI workloads imply rising data-center electricity requirements, but CEG's evidence remains comparatively thin.
theses.dissent: Lobbying and app engagement do not necessarily translate into incremental margins, and the 60-day relative weakness may reflect unresolved monetization or regulatory concerns.

falsifier.text: App engagement and model-download momentum roll over without a corresponding improvement in relative performance.

theses.thesis_zh: 消费者应用需求、开发者动能、专利集群和游说投入构成了相对多元的经营信号 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [lobbying]。与Sam Altman的合作关系强化了AI平台逻辑 [actor:Sam Altman]。该股未被标记为过度延伸，但其相对收益为正，入场容错率低于GOOGL或NVDA；同时其中一个渠道只是媒体荐股，而非更扎实的经营证据 [cnbc_pick]。
second_order: NVDA — continued cloud AI deployment supports accelerator consumption.
MU — scaling cloud inference and training raises demand for memory capacity and bandwidth.
CEG — hyperscale data-center growth can lift power demand, subject to the thin company-specific evidence.
theses.dissent: The evidence lacks dark-pool, insider-buying, or contract-acceleration confirmation, while recent outperformance leaves less room for execution disappointment.

falsifier.text: App demand and developer momentum weaken while patent activity fails to translate into sustained platform adoption.

theses.thesis: Insider buying intensity, unanimous analyst bullishness, patent activity, and positive retail sentiment align around a memory-cycle recovery [insider_mspr] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Government-grant acceleration is also strong in the metrics, although it is not listed as one of the scored convergence channels [gov_grant_accel]. The stock is non-extended, but the five-channel score includes softer affiliation and retail inputs, keeping conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: 内部人买入强度、分析师一致看多、专利活动和正面散户情绪共同指向存储周期复苏 [insider_mspr] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。指标中的政府补助增速也很强，但并未被列为该股已评分的汇聚渠道 [gov_grant_accel]。股价未过度延伸，但五项信号中包含较软的关联和散户输入，因此置信度维持低位。
second_order: NVDA — stronger memory demand would corroborate sustained AI-accelerator production and deployment.
INTC — domestic semiconductor support is thematically adjacent, though its own signals are weaker and relative performance is poor.
QCOM — broader semiconductor-cycle improvement could aid adjacent chip demand, but its evidence points more to patents and congressional buying.
theses.dissent: Analyst unanimity and retail optimism can be late-cycle signals, and the pack provides no direct demand, contract, or dark-pool confirmation for MU.

falsifier.text: Insider support disappears and analyst sentiment deteriorates without confirmation from end-demand indicators.

theses.thesis: Insider buying, accelerating government grants, patent activity, and bullish investor sentiment align around a potential operational and policy-supported recovery [insider_mspr] [gov_grant] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Jim Cramer's endorsement is additive but qualitative and should carry little weight [actor:Jim Cramer]. Defense authorization activity provides a broad sector backdrop, not a BA-specific award [bill:HRES1438]. The shares are non-extended and have lagged SPY, but the evidence does not establish execution improvement.
theses.thesis_zh: 内部人买入、加速的政府补助、专利活动和看多投资者情绪共同指向潜在的经营修复及政策支持 [insider_mspr] [gov_grant] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。Jim Cramer的背书仅属定性补充，应赋予较低权重 [actor:Jim Cramer]。国防授权进展只构成行业背景，并非BA特定订单 [bill:HRES1438]。股价未过度延伸且跑输SPY，但这些证据尚不能证明执行层面已改善。
second_order: SPCX — a broader aerospace recovery could benefit the space-sector basket, although its own convergence is limited to positioning and media channels.
PLTR — continued federal and defense spending can support government technology procurement, backed by its own contract signal.
CEG — defense and industrial activity can support power demand only indirectly; company-specific linkage is weak.
theses.dissent: Grant activity and sentiment can coexist with persistent production, certification, or execution problems, none of which the pack directly tests.

falsifier.text: Government support stops accelerating while insider buying fades and operational execution does not improve.
